title: Wedding Bride and Groom
author: AliEmbroidery
description:
Wedding Bride and Groom Embroidery Design. Wedding Designs. This is a representation of a bride and groom in a stylized or detailed embroidered form. The size of the embroidery design can vary, allowing for versatility in its use. It might be designed for framing as a keepsake, embellishing wedding attire, or used on accessories like ring pillows.
These designs capture the romance and significance of the wedding day, making them cherished mementos for couples celebrating their special union.
This machine embroidery design comes with multiple embroidery file formats and can be used with multiple embroidery machines.
